decisions.requirement: England and Wales first, from earliest usable parish registers onward; international expansion later.
decisions.verification: English/Welsh country-specific datasets, place rules and source metadata; extension interface.

decisions.requirement: GEDCOM imports plus manual entry and AI expansion from documented known ancestors.
decisions.verification: Import fixture with names, events, citations; no duplicate import; manual entry.

decisions.requirement: AI may search, interpret and score; uncertain merges and relationships require user approval.
decisions.verification: No direct mutation of accepted tree from autonomous candidate results.

decisions.requirement: Hybrid local Windows website/database and local processing with optional OpenAI cloud API.
decisions.verification: Application works with cloud AI disabled and never silently transmits records.

decisions.requirement: Start with lawful free sources, authorised APIs, manual file imports; consider subscriptions/bulk data later.
decisions.verification: Provider capability and licence gate prevent prohibited automated access.

decisions.requirement: Gramps Web as genealogy foundation; separate research database and AI modules.
decisions.verification: Accepted people persist in Gramps; research records stored separately.

decisions.requirement: Prioritise civil BMD, censuses and parish registers, then probate, newspapers and specialist sources.
decisions.verification: Connector priorities and record schema cover the first three source classes.

decisions.requirement: Research ancestors, siblings, spouses, descendants and surrounding households, expanding progressively.
decisions.verification: Expansion jobs use bounded breadth/depth, place and time constraints.

decisions.requirement: Retain alternative relationships, complete hypothetical branches, probabilities, evidence and unknown options.
decisions.verification: Conflicting parent candidates coexist without destructive replacement.

decisions.requirement: Integrated tree, document viewer, evidence comparison, candidate matches and AI research assistant.
decisions.verification: UX navigation accepts selected person and displays coordinated panes.

decisions.requirement: Preserve original records or permitted links, transcriptions, citations, provenance and AI interpretations separately; immutable evidence.
decisions.verification: Original assertion remains unchanged after transcript correction.

decisions.requirement: Use statistical/historical matching AND AI language-model analysis as separate evidence contributors.
decisions.verification: Traceable independent model outputs; AI cannot assert calibrated probabilities alone.

decisions.requirement: Connected Bayesian/evidence-based relationship models calibrated with known cases, unknown option and contradictions.
decisions.verification: Alternatives and unknown normalise; held-out calibration report.

decisions.requirement: Private local installation, basic password protection and standard backups; no elaborate user security initially.
decisions.verification: Loopback-only listener; password gate; recoverable data/media backup.

decisions.requirement: Small focused pilot first; architecture allows incremental millions-scale processing with tested recovery.
decisions.verification: Index and batching plan; 100k synthetic stress benchmark; restore drill.

decisions.requirement: Time-aware English county, parish, registration district, neighbours, boundaries and migration geography.
decisions.verification: Historical date-specific place resolution includes abolished/renamed districts.

decisions.requirement: Historical name variants, phonetics, aliases, nicknames, maiden names and transcription errors preserved.
decisions.verification: Variant matcher compares differing spellings but returns original forms.

decisions.requirement: Reconstruct and link households across censuses including departures, births, marriages and migration.
decisions.verification: 1841 vs 1851 census conventions enforced using fixture households.

decisions.requirement: Expose three modes: autonomous research, AI-guided manual searches and conventional manual search with AI summaries.
decisions.verification: User can switch modes; progress persists; permissions consistent.

decisions.requirement: Investigate conflicts, rank hypotheses and queue material accepted-tree modifications for approval.
decisions.verification: Conflicting candidates remain separate after review rejection.

decisions.requirement: Explore parents, children, siblings, spouses, relatives and connected households in bounded provisional branches.
decisions.verification: Expansion stops at configurable generation, result and cost caps.

decisions.requirement: Connected dependency-aware probabilistic family graph with historical constraints, unknowns and recalculation.
decisions.verification: No independent multiplication where evidence or events are shared.

decisions.requirement: Prioritise research by expected uncertainty reduction, availability, cost and effort.
decisions.verification: Planner emits auditable ranked searches and budget rationale.

decisions.requirement: On new evidence reevaluate affected connections; preserve past results and seek approvals for accepted-tree changes.
decisions.verification: Versioned hypotheses and impact/review queues.

decisions.requirement: Interactive alternative trees, probabilities, source links, geography, timelines, and whole-branch comparisons.
decisions.verification: Comparative view includes 2 hypotheses and unknown relationship.

decisions.requirement: Auto-search authorised APIs/licensed data; restricted sources get manual-assisted links/imports only.
decisions.verification: Policy registry blocks automatic queries to manual-only providers.

decisions.requirement: Pilot family/county dataset, research licensed bulk sources in parallel, expand after validation.
decisions.verification: Pilot selection and licensed acquisition gate documented.

decisions.requirement: Local handwriting recognition plus optional specialist cloud, AI extraction, original image and correction trail.
decisions.verification: Manual transcription edit never alters original image or prior run.

decisions.requirement: Unified search catalogue with provider-specific observations, rights, IDs, URLs and provenance; avoid double counting.
decisions.verification: Two copies of same census observation deduplicated at evidence-family level.

decisions.requirement: Background resumable jobs, caching, source throttling, budgets, cost reporting and paid-acquisition approval.
decisions.verification: Pause/resume, idempotent retry, budget exceed hard-stop.

decisions.requirement: Multiple zoomable ancestor, descendant, hourglass, relationship and fan charts with optional AI overlays.
decisions.verification: All views preserve selected individual and navigate correctly.

decisions.requirement: Accepted tree with toggleable visually distinct alternatives and complete hypothesis comparison.
decisions.verification: Conflicting branches and unknown category distinguishable without relying on colour.

decisions.requirement: Integrated zoomable original image, editable AI transcription, linked citations, and side-by-side fact comparison.
decisions.verification: Correction is audit logged, original image immutable.

decisions.requirement: Natural-language AI assistant and guided actions for cited research and proposed changes requiring approval.
decisions.verification: No assistant-origin accepted-tree write without reviewed action.

decisions.requirement: Research dashboard tracks jobs, discoveries, misses, uncertainty, budgets, approvals; pause/resume/cancel.
decisions.verification: State changes and usage metrics are displayed accurately.

decisions.requirement: ChatGPT prepares specs, modular code, tests and prompts; external coder integrates and reports validation.
decisions.verification: Work-package manifest, clear integration instructions and evidence template.

decisions.requirement: Git increments, migrations, backups, compatibility checks and rollback preserving data.
decisions.verification: Rollback tested on representative data; no destructive auto-upgrade.

decisions.requirement: Automated unit, integration, browser, genealogy, probability and backup/restore tests.
decisions.verification: Required checks enforceable as CI/acceptance gates.

decisions.requirement: Windows Docker persistent installation, shortcuts, health checks and backups to project folder.
decisions.verification: Windows installation smoke test and local-only port binding.

decisions.requirement: Incrementally merge independently validated work packages, releasing only with acceptance reports.
decisions.verification: No package is marked accepted before recorded tests.

decisions.requirement: Apply Genealogical Proof Standard, source/information/evidence classifications and cited conflict resolution.
decisions.verification: Assessment distinguishes direct, indirect, negative and derivative evidence.

decisions.requirement: Historically contextual consistency rules with impossible vs atypical and adoption/remarriage exceptions.
decisions.verification: Fixtures exercise known false positives and unusual legitimate families.

decisions.requirement: Independently reviewed English genealogy gold-standard benchmarks, varied periods and hard negatives.
decisions.verification: Report precision, recall, false merges, missed links, relationship accuracy.

decisions.requirement: Calibrate probabilities with held-out cases by time period, record class and surname; show uncertainty.
decisions.verification: Reliability diagrams/Brier score/coverage and abstention metrics.

decisions.requirement: Log accepted/rejected examples with reasons; controlled retraining/evaluation/versioning/rollback.
decisions.verification: No model promotion unless independent holdout and regression gates pass.

decisions.requirement: Continuously usable releases; foundation then records, AI matching, reconstruction and autonomous research.
decisions.verification: Each release starts and retains previous core functions.

decisions.requirement: Integrate only via documented, versioned Gramps REST API; separate research DB; approved adapter writes.
decisions.verification: Contract tests prove no direct Gramps database writes.

decisions.requirement: First Windows release: persistent Gramps, login, imports, research interface, health, backup/restore and shortcuts; live checkout/data outside OneDrive.
decisions.verification: Complete locally performed install and cold backup/restore drill required.

decisions.requirement: Require traceability, automated regression, integrity/probability/security validation, rollback and acceptance report.
decisions.verification: Package gate rejects absent evidence or failed checks.

decisions.requirement: Master Specification Rev A; 50-decision register; versioned schemas/APIs; modular prompts; traceability; PRs and history.
decisions.verification: Generated source docs and verification report cross-reference Q1-Q50.
